faq.q: What is the origin of Arshid?
faq.a: Arshid is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of أرشد ('most rightly guided').
Yes — the underlying form أرشد is Arabic.
Arshid can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Arshid should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. root ر ش د occurs in the Qur'an; أرشد is a normal Arabic elative
